title: EliteMobs automatic shared weapon prerequisite XP, addon-only
assumptions: Before: one native eligible weapon award E goes to its attributed skill. After: source+one eligible prerequisite recipient receive exactly E total; no multiplication and no deduction of pre-existing XP.

Low/base/high sensitivity only: 50/200/1000 eligible combat awards per active player-day at a hypothetical 100 XP each, equivalent to 0.5/2/5 hours at 100/100/200 awards per hour. These are not measured rates.
5/20/50 participating players are scenario assumptions. Native contribution, level eligibility, reinforcement, natural-kill cap and dungeon lockout checks remain before the addon hook.
ARMOR skill XP and Advanced Combat class XP keep separate unchanged native award paths. Existing skill perks apply once before redistribution; books/admin writes are not shared combat awards.

At equal prior XP, paired progression ordinarily divides the award equally; existing differences are caught up using only newly earned XP. At least one source XP may remain native to preserve zero-veto compatibility.
Vault, tokens, EliteMobs crystals and item issuance have zero direct delta. No currency exchange or item resale is assumed. Current SELL and planned contract transition are not modified.
Real time to a level cannot be guaranteed by XP conservation alone: equipment access, combat level and kill throughput can change. Existing 168h audit covers only vault/tokens, not skill XP.
Sum budget across all overlapping classes is one award E, never one award per pair. No transitive redistribution; no player-selected extra training target and no class/ability unlock bypass.

Persist both skill totals through the existing native PlayerData queue and cross-server EmSync snapshot. No new storage or blocking gameplay-thread I/O. Final cancellation and a late changed/zero award must not grant companion XP.
